failure_reason: Argos homepage (/) and every /browse/* category page returned Akamai Bot Manager 403 'Access Denied' on all attempts across all three access tiers tried live today: curl_cffi impersonating 7 browser profiles (chrome124, chrome120, chrome131, safari184_ios, safari18_0_ios, safari15_5, edge101), Playwright headless Chromium, and a real Claude-in-Chrome browser session. This blocks direct inspection of the site's main nav/mega-menu and any per-category 'Best Sellers' tab/sort. No archive/proxy substitute (Wayback, r.jina.ai, translate.goog) was used per rules, so this conclusion rests on the other live-reachable evidence described in notes rather than a full nav traversal.
notes: Despite the homepage/browse block, extensive live evidence points to no genuine Bestsellers PLP existing for Home & Furniture (or site-wide): (1) Direct slug probing -- /best-sellers, /bestsellers, /top-sellers, /popular, /customer-favourites, /customer-favorites, /trending, /most-popular all returned a real, consistent site 404 template (3690 bytes) across profiles, proving the path namespace itself is reachable (not blocked) and these routes simply don't exist. (2) Sitemap enumeration -- fetched and regex-searched all reachable sitemaps (browse_sitemap.xml: 1492 URLs, browse_refined_sitemap.xml: 7235 URLs, sd_sitemap.xml: 4226 URLs, other_sitemap.xml, features_events_sitemap.xml) for bestseller/top-seller/popular/trending/customer-favourite keywords -- zero relevant hits. (3) /list/best-sellers/ returns HTTP 200 but was proven to be a generic templated search-results fallback, not a curated PLP: title is 'Results for best sellers', meta robots=noindex, and description is a canned 'Get set for best sellers at Argos' -- reproducing the identical templated response for a nonsense slug (/list/zzznonsenseterm123/, title 'Results for zzznonsenseterm123') confirms this URL shape auto-generates for any input string. Excluded per the brief's search-results-page rule. (4) Retrieved the live, un-filtered Home & Furniture category tree (embedded categoryData JSON from the accessible /clearance/home-and-furniture/c:29351/ page) and found a mega-menu section heading literally named 'Popular Now' -- but its own url field is identical to its parent 'Home and furniture' node's URL (both /browse/home-and-furniture/c:29351/), meaning it is a menu-grouping label for a handful of sub-categories (Beds, etc.), not a separately visitable listing/PLP -- excluded per the brief's PLP-boundary test (must be an actual, distinct listing you can open). No genuine Bestsellers concept was found anywhere reachable; the residual gap is only the blocked homepage mega-menu and live /browse/* pages, which is why status is 'partial' rather than 'ok'.
